# What will video hosting cost for your minutes stored and watched, and who is cheapest?

> Type your minutes stored, minutes watched per month and growth rate, get every video-hosting platform priced side by side and the viewing level where the cheapest one changes. No account, no upload.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [How to choose video hosting by minutes watched](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/video-hosting-pricing-calculator/how-to-choose-video-hosting-by-minutes-watched.html)
